description:
DMX lighting controller that records, stores, and plays back lighting shows.

DMX Core 100 records lighting shows from your lighting software, stores them, and plays them back
on schedules or on demand. Playback can be triggered from the built-in web interface, schedules,
the Web API, or external protocols such as OSC, MQTT, MIDI, and Stream Deck. Output goes over
sACN, Art-Net, and KiNet. This desktop edition runs the same software as the DMX Core 100
wall-mounted appliance.
Fixed recording protocol selection when input mappings change; improved security by hiding default PIN hint on configured systems and preventing auto-login bypass.
